why: Intro to Git and GitHub plan (docs/ui-next/catalog/plans/intro-git.json), 'Set up Git and make a repository' (passes: cookbook is a Git repository on a branch named main and user.name is set). The learner's git predates a configured default, so plain `git init` printed the long 'Using 'master' as the name for the initial branch' hint; they renamed it right away with `git branch -m main` (silent before the first commit). `git config user.name` prints Ada Learner and `git status` says 'On branch main'. 'master' is on screen only inside git's hint. Done.

step.title: Make the cookbook repository
step.instructions: Make a folder named cookbook and go into it. Run git init -b main, set your name with git config --global user.name "Your Name", and check it with git config user.name.

Terminal: hint: Using 'master' as the name for the initial branch. This default branch name
hint: is subject to change. To configure the initial branch name to use in all
hint: of your new repositories, which will suppress this warning, call:

hint: 'development'. The just-created branch can be renamed via this command:
tripi@mac cookbook % git config --global user.name "Ada Learner"
